text_en: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
text_cn: 以下是以色列的儿子：勒乌本、西默盎、肋未、犹大、依撒加尔、则步隆、

text_en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
text_cn: 丹、若瑟、本雅明、纳斐塔里、加得和阿协尔。

text_en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; these three the Canaanite woman Bath-shua bore to him. Now Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord , and he put him to death.
text_cn: 犹大的儿子：厄尔、敖难和舍拉。此三人是客纳罕人叔亚的女儿所生。犹大的长子厄尔行了上主所厌恶的事，上主叫他死了。

text_en: His daughter-in-law Tamar also bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
text_cn: 犹大的儿媳塔玛尔给他生了培勒兹和则辣黑：犹大共有五个儿子。

text_en: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
text_cn: 培勒兹的儿子：赫兹龙和哈慕耳。

text_en: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five in all.
text_cn: 则辣黑的儿子：齐默黎、厄堂、赫曼、加耳苛耳和达辣，共五人。

text_en: The sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the matter of the devoted thing;
text_cn: 加尔米的儿子：阿加尔，他违犯了毁灭律，使以色列受了害。

text_en: and Ethan’s son was Azariah.
text_cn: 厄堂的儿子：阿匝黎雅。

text_en: The sons of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
text_cn: 赫兹龙生的儿子：耶辣默耳、兰和革路拜。

text_en: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah.
text_cn: 兰生阿米纳达布，阿米纳达布生纳赫雄──犹大子孙的首领。

text_en: Nahshon became the father of Salma, Salma of Boaz,
text_cn: 纳赫雄生撒耳玛，撒耳玛生波阿次，

text_en: Boaz of Obed, Obed of Jesse.
text_cn: 波阿次生敖贝得，敖贝得生叶瑟，

text_en: Jesse became the father of Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
text_cn: 叶瑟生长子厄里雅布，次子阿彼纳达布，三子史默亚，

text_en: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
text_cn: 四子乃塔乃耳，五子辣待，

text_en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
text_cn: 六子敖曾，七子达味；

text_en: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
text_cn: 他们的姊妹是责鲁雅和阿彼盖耳。责鲁雅生阿彼瑟、约阿布和阿撒耳三人。

text_en: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
text_cn: 阿彼盖耳生阿玛撒；阿玛撒的父亲是依市玛耳人耶特尔。

text_en: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah, and by Jerioth; these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
text_cn: 赫兹龙的儿子加肋布，由妻子阿组巴生耶黎敖特，她还生了耶舍尔、芍巴布和阿尔冬。

text_en: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
text_cn: 阿组巴死后，加肋布又娶了厄弗辣大，她生了胡尔。

text_en: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
text_cn: 胡尔生乌黎；乌黎生贝匝肋耳。

text_en: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub;
text_cn: 赫兹龙以后走近基肋阿得的父亲玛基尔的女儿，娶她时，已六十岁，她生了色古布。

text_en: and Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
text_cn: 色古布生雅依尔，他在基肋阿得占有二十三座城市。

text_en: But Geshur and Aram took from them Havvoth-jair, Kenath and its villages, sixty towns. All these were descendants of Machir, father of Gilead.
text_cn: 但以后革叔尔和阿兰却占领了雅依尔的村落，以及刻纳特和所属的六十座村镇：以上全是基肋阿得的父亲玛基尔的子孙。

text_en: After the death of Hezron, in Caleb-ephrathah, Abijah wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur, father of Tekoa.
text_cn: 赫兹龙死后，加肋布走近父亲的妻子厄弗辣大，她生了特科亚的父亲阿市胡尔。

text_en: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
text_cn: 赫兹龙的长子耶辣默耳的儿子：长子是兰，其次是步纳、敖愣、敖曾和阿希雅。

text_en: Jerahmeel also had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
text_cn: 此外，耶辣默耳有另一个妻子，名叫阿塔辣，她是敖南的母亲。

text_en: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
text_cn: 耶辣默耳的长子兰的儿子：玛阿兹、雅明和厄刻尔。

text_en: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
text_cn: 敖南的儿子：沙买和雅达；沙买的儿子：纳达布和阿彼叔尔。

text_en: The name of Abishur’s wife was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
text_cn: 阿彼叔尔的妻子名叫阿彼海耳，生子阿赫班和摩里得。

text_en: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; and Seled died childless.
text_cn: 纳达布的儿子：色肋得和阿帕殷；色肋得没有儿子，死了。

text_en: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
text_cn: 阿帕殷的儿子：依史；依史的儿子：舍商；舍商的儿子：阿赫来。

text_en: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died childless.
text_cn: 沙买的兄弟雅达的儿子：耶特尔和约纳堂；耶特尔没有儿子，死了。

text_en: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
text_cn: 约纳堂的儿子：培肋特和匝匝：以上是耶辣默耳的子孙。

text_en: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters; but Sheshan had an Egyptian slave, whose name was Jarha.
text_cn: 舍商没有儿子，只有女儿；舍商有个埃及仆人，名叫雅尔哈。

text_en: So Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his slave Jarha; and she bore him Attai.
text_cn: 舍商将女儿嫁给仆人雅尔哈为妻，给他生了阿泰。

text_en: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan of Zabad.
text_cn: 阿泰生纳堂；纳堂生匝巴得；

text_en: Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal of Obed.
text_cn: 匝巴得生厄弗拉耳；厄弗拉耳生敖贝得；

text_en: Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu of Azariah.
text_cn: 敖贝得生耶胡；耶胡生阿匝黎雅；

text_en: Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez of Eleasah.
text_cn: 阿匝黎雅生赫肋兹；赫肋兹生厄拉撒；

text_en: Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai of Shallum.
text_cn: 厄拉撒生息斯买；息斯买生沙隆；

text_en: Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah of Elishama.
text_cn: 沙隆生耶卡米雅；耶卡米雅生厄里沙玛。

text_en: The sons of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was father of Ziph. The sons of Mareshah father of Hebron.
text_cn: 耶辣默耳的兄弟加肋布的子孙：他的长子是玛勒沙，他是齐弗的父亲。玛勒沙的儿子：赫贝龙。

text_en: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
text_cn: 赫贝龙的儿子：科辣黑、塔普亚、勒耿和舍玛。

text_en: Shema became father of Raham, father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
text_cn: 舍玛生约尔刻罕的父亲辣罕；勒耿生沙买。

text_en: The son of Shammai: Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
text_cn: 沙买的儿子：玛红；玛红是贝特族尔的父亲。

text_en: Ephah also, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
text_cn: 加肋布的妾厄法生哈郎、摩匝和加则次。哈郎生加则次。

text_en: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
text_cn: 雅赫待的儿子：勒根、约堂、革商、培肋特、厄法和沙阿夫。

text_en: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
text_cn: 加肋布的妾玛阿加生舍贝尔和提尔哈纳；

text_en: She also bore Shaaph father of Madmannah, Sheva father of Machbenah and father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
text_cn: 又生了玛德玛纳的父亲沙阿夫、玛革贝纳和基贝亚的父亲舍瓦；加肋布的女儿：阿革撒：

text_en: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal father of Kiriath-jearim,
text_cn: 以上是加肋布的子孙。厄弗辣大的长子胡尔的儿子：克黎雅特耶阿陵的父亲芍巴耳、

text_en: Salma father of Bethlehem, and Hareph father of Beth-gader.
text_cn: 白冷的父亲撒耳玛和贝特加德尔的父亲哈勒夫。

text_en: Shobal father of Kiriath-jearim had other sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
text_cn: 克黎雅特耶阿陵的父亲芍巴耳的儿子是：勒阿雅和半个部落玛纳哈特人；

text_en: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
text_cn: 克黎雅特耶阿陵的家族是：耶特尔人、普特人、叔玛人和米市辣人；从他们又生出祚辣人和厄市陶耳人。

text_en: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
text_cn: 撒耳玛的子孙是：白冷、乃托法人、阿托贝特约阿布、一半部落玛纳哈特人和祚辣人。

text_en: The families also of the scribes that lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, father of the house of Rechab.
text_cn: 住在雅贝兹的色斐尔的家族是：提辣人、沙玛人和稣加人：他们是刻尼人，贝特勒加布的父亲哈玛特的后代。
